photos.title: Oceanfront condo buildings and the beach north of Myrtle Beach, USGS oblique aerial photo, August 24, 2011
photos.what: Seen from a plane over the ocean: a long 13-story condo building and part of a taller tower stand at the back of a wide sandy beach, with beach umbrellas along the water. To the left, a grassy dune and a swash, a tidal creek, meet the beach. Behind the buildings are a golf course, ponds, live oaks and a few large houses. People are specks; no sign, plate or name is readable.
photos.caption: Oceanfront condo buildings beside a swash, a tidal creek, north of Myrtle Beach in 2011.
photos.alt: A long oceanfront condo building and part of a taller tower at the back of a wide beach with umbrellas, a grassy dune and a tidal creek to the left, a golf course behind, seen from over the ocean

place.sublocation: The oceanfront north of the city of Myrtle Beach, in the Arcadian Shores stretch of Horry County
